==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
A shortening of {{m|en|country and western}}. This version has been predominant since the 1950s.

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-country music.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|-}}

# {{lb|en|music}} A [[style]] of popular music that originated in the [[folk music]] of the [[rural]] population of the [[southern]] and [[western]] [[United States]] and characterized by string-band instruments and simple melodies.
#: {{ux|en|He's a handsome '''country''' singer who plays the guitar with his beautiful girlfriend who plays the drums!}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|music}} {{l|en|country}}, {{l|en|country-western music}}, {{l|en|country and western}}

====Coordinate terms====
* {{l|en|old-time country}} {{q|considered either coordinate or hyponymous}}
* {{l|en|bluegrass}}
* {{l|en|blues}}
* {{l|en|gospel music}}
* {{l|en|rock 'n' roll}}
